literal: Only for suffering / receptacle / alas / family (acc.) / fault / he who shields / body.
translation: Is the body of the man who shields his family from faults merely a receptacle for suffering?
modern: தன் குடும்பத்திற்குக் குற்றம் வராமல் காப்பவனின் உடம்பு, துன்பத்தை மட்டுமே தாங்கும் கொள்கலமோ?
explanation: This couplet reflects on the immense burden borne by one who takes responsibility for their family. The word 'மறைப்பான்' means one who shields or protects the family from faults, blame, or decline. The poet wonders with pity if such a person's body was created merely to be a vessel for endless suffering. It highlights the selfless, often painful sacrifices required to maintain a family's honor and well-being.
